key_insight: MentalHospital is a virtual psychiatric exam environment that evaluates LLMs across the full S.O.A.P. clinical encounter, not just isolated tasks.
clinical_relevance: It offers a more realistic way to test whether AI can conduct psychiatric interviews, reason diagnostically, and plan treatment in a clinically coherent workflow.
method: Built from 1,193 de-identified psychiatric EHR cases spanning major ICD-11 categories and 76 disorders
Uses skill-augmented standardized patients to simulate full Subjective, Objective, Assessment, and Plan encounters
Adds MentalEval, five specialized evaluators for empathy, professionalism, note quality, diagnostic rigor, and treatment appropriateness
evidence_signal: The authors report clinician survey support for clinical fidelity (3.88/5), MentalEval expert alignment with average QWK 0.944, and a 37.28-point gap between the strongest LLM and clinicians in objective psychiatric competence.
watch_item: Because the benchmark relies on simulated patients and rubric-based scoring, results may not fully capture real-world psychiatric complexity, safety risks, or local practice differences.
paper_title: MentalHospital: A Virtual Environment for Evaluating Psychiatric Clinical Encounters
